cards.thai: เชื่อมโยงและส่งผลถึงกัน
cards.meaning: Connected so that parts can affect one another.
cards.simple: Parts affect other parts.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows describes systems through connections that produce behavior.
cards.example: Our intake and review steps are interconnected.

cards.thai: รูปแบบพฤติกรรมที่เกิดขึ้นตามเวลา
cards.meaning: A recognizable way something behaves over time.
cards.simple: What keeps happening over time.
cards.book_ctx: The definition emphasizes a system's behavior through time.
cards.example: We need several weeks of data to identify a pattern of behavior.

cards.thai: โครงสร้างหรือการจัดวางความสัมพันธ์
cards.meaning: The arrangement that makes a particular response possible.
cards.simple: How the parts are arranged.
cards.book_ctx: The spring and box behave differently because of their construction.
cards.example: Changing the approval structure may change waiting time.

cards.thai: กระตุ้นให้เกิด / จุดชนวน
cards.meaning: To start or release a response.
cards.simple: To make something start.
cards.book_ctx: Outside events can activate behavior shaped by the system.
cards.example: A new request can trigger a review.

cards.thai: แฝงอยู่ ยังไม่แสดงออก
cards.meaning: Present as a possibility but not yet expressed.
cards.simple: There, but not active yet.
cards.book_ctx: The spring has possible behavior released by handling it.
cards.example: The process has a latent weakness that appears during busy periods.

cards.thai: มีอยู่ในลักษณะหรือโครงสร้างของสิ่งนั้น
cards.meaning: Belonging to the nature or arrangement of something.
cards.simple: Part of how something works.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows uses this idea when connecting recurring behavior to structure.
cards.example: Some waiting is inherent in a weekly approval schedule.

cards.thai: เปราะบางต่อผลกระทบ
cards.meaning: Easily affected or disrupted under certain conditions.
cards.simple: Easy to disrupt.
cards.book_ctx: An illustration relates supply interruptions to existing dependence.
cards.example: A workflow with only one reviewer is vulnerable to absence.

cards.thai: โดยอาศัยความเข้าใจจากประสบการณ์ โดยยังไม่ได้วิเคราะห์เป็นขั้นตอน
cards.meaning: Through practical familiarity, without explicit step-by-step analysis.
cards.simple: You understand it without explaining every step.
cards.book_ctx: People develop practical understanding of complex systems before formal study.
cards.example: I intuitively expect a delay, but I need to examine the process.

cards.thai: วงจรป้อนกลับแบบเสริมแรง
cards.meaning: A circular connection in which an outcome strengthens conditions that support more of that outcome.
cards.simple: A result helps produce more of the same result.
cards.book_ctx: Rewards from winning can provide the means for future wins.
cards.example: Early visibility may start a reinforcing feedback loop of opportunities and further visibility.

cards.thai: การมีส่วนหรือเส้นทางสำรองที่ทดแทนกันได้
cards.meaning: Additional or overlapping pathways that can provide alternatives if one fails.
cards.simple: Another way is available if one way fails.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows pairs multiple pathways and redundancy with lower vulnerability to shocks.
cards.example: A backup review route adds redundancy to the process.
cards.usage: In this passage it does not mean dismissal from a job.

cards.thai: แรงกระทบหรือเหตุสะเทือนจากภายนอกระบบ
cards.meaning: A disturbance coming from outside the system being considered.
cards.simple: A sudden outside change that affects the system.
cards.book_ctx: The diversity comparison concerns the response to outside disturbance.
cards.example: A supplier outage is an external shock to this workflow.

cards.thai: แนวคิดที่อธิบายสิ่งซับซ้อนโดยแยกศึกษาส่วนย่อย
cards.meaning: An approach that explains problems by examining smaller parts, contrasted here with attention to wholes.
cards.simple: Study smaller parts to understand a problem.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows acknowledges the benefits of science, logic, and reductionism before discussing their limits for some persistent problems.
cards.example: Studying each task separately may miss how handoffs connect the tasks.

cards.thai: เป็นส่วนหนึ่งและเชื่อมโยงอยู่ภายใน
cards.meaning: Situated within and connected to a larger context.
cards.simple: Part of something larger.
cards.book_ctx: Solutions operate within larger systems.
cards.example: The approval tool is embedded in a wider workflow.

cards.thai: ยังคงอยู่ แม้พยายามแก้ไขแล้ว
cards.meaning: Continue to exist despite efforts to change or end something.
cards.simple: Keep happening or remain.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows discusses problems that continue despite analytical and technical effort.
cards.example: The delay may persist if the same approval dependency remains.

cards.thai: ปรับโครงสร้างหรือความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างส่วนต่าง ๆ
cards.meaning: Change the arrangement of a system.
cards.simple: Change how the parts are arranged.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows calls for examining and changing structures behind persistent problems.
cards.example: Before we restructure the process, we need evidence about which dependency causes waiting.

cards.thai: รู้สึกระแวงหรือไม่สบายใจกับสิ่งที่ยังไม่คุ้น
cards.meaning: Cautious or uneasy about something unfamiliar.
cards.simple: Not fully comfortable with something.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows addresses readers who may feel uneasy about systems terminology.
cards.example: A reader may be wary of unfamiliar technical terms.

cards.thai: พร้อมกัน / ในเวลาเดียวกัน
cards.meaning: At the same time.
cards.simple: Happening together.
cards.book_ctx: Connections in systems operate in several directions at once.
cards.example: Several teams can be affected simultaneously.

cards.thai: ภาษาที่ใช้ภาพหรือแผนภาพสื่อความหมาย
cards.meaning: A way to represent ideas through pictures and diagrams.
cards.simple: Show ideas using pictures.
cards.book_ctx: Meadows will introduce system pictures gradually.
cards.example: A graphical language can help us inspect relationships.

cards.thai: เสริมกันและกัน
cards.meaning: useful together because each adds something.
cards.simple: Each helps the other.
cards.book_ctx: systems thinking and reductionist thinking provide different useful views.
cards.example: Process data and interviews can be complementary.

cards.thai: รูปแบบโครงสร้างที่พบซ้ำ
cards.meaning: a recurring kind of structure associated with recognizable behavior.
cards.simple: A common kind of pattern.
cards.book_ctx: roadmap names recurring system structures as traps and opportunities; detailed mechanisms remain unread.
cards.example: We need to inspect the connections before calling this an archetype.

cards.thai: ความเชื่อมโยงระหว่างส่วนต่าง ๆ
cards.meaning: A relationship linking parts
cards.simple: A relationship linking parts
cards.book_ctx: Physical flows, rules and signals
cards.example: Identify the interconnection between intake and review.

cards.thai: อนุมานจากหลักฐาน
cards.meaning: Infer from evidence or reasoning
cards.simple: Infer from evidence or reasoning
cards.book_ctx: Purpose inferred from behavior
cards.example: We cannot deduce intent from one result.

cards.thai: ปริมาณสะสม
cards.meaning: An amount accumulated at a time
cards.simple: An amount accumulated at a time
cards.book_ctx: Water, wood, money
cards.example: Open requests are a possible stock.

cards.thai: การไหลเข้าออกตามเวลา
cards.meaning: What adds or removes over time
cards.simple: What adds or removes over time
cards.book_ctx: Filling, draining, births, deaths
cards.example: Count the flow of resolved requests per day.

cards.thai: สมดุลพลวัต
cards.meaning: Constant amount with balanced ongoing flows
cards.simple: Constant amount with balanced ongoing flows
cards.book_ctx: Equal bathtub inflow/outflow
cards.example: Stable inventory can coexist with daily sales.

cards.thai: ความแตกต่างระหว่างค่าจริงกับค่าที่ต้องการ
cards.meaning: Difference between actual and desired level
cards.simple: Difference between actual and desired level
cards.book_ctx: Drives balancing action
cards.example: The queue threshold creates a discrepancy when waiting work exceeds it.

cards.thai: มุ่งเข้าสู่เป้าหมาย
cards.meaning: Acting to move toward a target or range
cards.simple: Acting to move toward a target or range
cards.book_ctx: Balancing feedback
cards.example: A thermostat is goal-seeking around its setting.

cards.thai: ถูกจำกัดด้วยทรัพยากร
cards.meaning: Limited by available people, money, time, or capacity
cards.simple: Limited by available people, money, time, or capacity
cards.book_ctx: Corrective action may be too constrained to work
cards.example: The review action is resource-constrained during peak demand.

cards.thai: แบบทวีคูณ
cards.meaning: Changing at a rate proportional to the current amount
cards.simple: Changing at a rate proportional to the current amount
cards.book_ctx: Compound interest accelerates
cards.example: A constant percentage addition produces exponential growth.

cards.thai: ขยายหรือเสริมแรง
cards.meaning: Make a change larger or stronger
cards.simple: Make a change larger or stronger
cards.book_ctx: Reinforcing feedback
cards.example: Reinvestment can amplify productive capacity.

cards.thai: ชดเชยผลที่ยังเกิดอยู่
cards.meaning: Counteract an ongoing effect
cards.simple: Counteract an ongoing effect
cards.book_ctx: A stock-maintaining loop must account for continuing drains or inflows
cards.example: Hiring may need to compensate for departures during the hiring period.

cards.thai: จุดที่กลไกแก้ไขรับมือไม่ไหว
cards.meaning: A condition beyond which a corrective loop cannot hold its goal
cards.simple: A condition beyond which a corrective loop cannot hold its goal
cards.book_ctx: Heat loss exceeds the furnace's ability to replace heat
cards.example: A capacity limit can reveal a loop's breakdown point.

cards.thai: ตามอัตราการเปลี่ยนแปลงให้ทัน
cards.meaning: Match the rate of an opposing change
cards.simple: Match the rate of an opposing change
cards.book_ctx: The furnace cannot replace heat as fast as it leaks out
cards.example: Completion must keep up with incoming work to prevent growth in the queue.

cards.thai: การเปลี่ยนวงจรที่มีอิทธิพลครอบงำ
cards.meaning: A change in which feedback loop has the strongest effect
cards.simple: A change in which feedback loop has the strongest effect
cards.book_ctx: Fertility and mortality changes move population among growth, balance, and decline
cards.example: A bend in the curve may indicate shifting dominance if the competing rates changed.

cards.thai: ปัจจัยขับเคลื่อน
cards.meaning: An input or condition assumed to influence system behavior
cards.simple: An input or condition assumed to influence system behavior
cards.book_ctx: Fertility and mortality drive the simple population scenarios
cards.example: State whether the driving factor is observed, assumed, or produced within the system.

cards.thai: ชุดรูปแบบพฤติกรรมที่เป็นไปได้
cards.meaning: The set of behaviors a structure can produce
cards.simple: The set of behaviors a structure can produce
cards.book_ctx: One reinforcing plus one balancing loop can grow, decline, stabilize, or shift among these
cards.example: The model's repertoire depends on its structure and changing parameters.

cards.thai: ความล่าช้าในการรับรู้
cards.meaning: Time between a change and its recognition as a usable signal
cards.simple: Time between a change and its recognition as a usable signal
cards.book_ctx: The dealer averages several days of sales before changing orders
cards.example: A weekly report creates a perception delay if daily changes matter.

cards.thai: ความล่าช้าในการตอบสนอง
cards.meaning: Time or gradual adjustment between recognition and changed action
cards.simple: Time or gradual adjustment between recognition and changed action
cards.book_ctx: The dealer corrects only part of the inventory shortfall per order
cards.example: A staged capacity change creates a response delay.

cards.thai: ความล่าช้าในการส่งมอบ
cards.meaning: Time between an action/order and its physical effect or arrival
cards.simple: Time between an action/order and its physical effect or arrival
cards.book_ctx: Factory orders take days to become dealership deliveries
cards.example: Work approved today may affect output only after implementation.

cards.thai: ลดความรุนแรงของการแกว่ง
cards.meaning: Reduce the size of repeated swings
cards.simple: Reduce the size of repeated swings
cards.book_ctx: Slower adjustment reduces inventory oscillation in this configuration
cards.example: The test damped the cycle without removing the target.

cards.thai: การร่อยหรอจากการใช้
cards.meaning: Reduction of a resource stock through use or extraction
cards.simple: Reduction of a resource stock through use or extraction
cards.book_ctx: Oil extraction drains a stock with no replenishing inflow
cards.example: Track depletion with a changing use rate, not only an initial-rate estimate.

cards.thai: ผลผลิตต่อหน่วยทุน
cards.meaning: Resource output obtained from each unit of productive capital
cards.simple: Resource output obtained from each unit of productive capital
cards.book_ctx: Scarcity lowers extraction yield and profit
cards.example: Falling yield can reveal the pathway from scarcity to weaker investment.

cards.thai: หลบเลี่ยงได้ชั่วคราว
cards.meaning: Avoid or escape for a time
cards.simple: Avoid or escape for a time
cards.book_ctx: Discoveries let growth loops evade control loops longer
cards.example: A local workaround may elude one constraint without removing it.

cards.thai: ฟื้นตัวหรือเพิ่มจำนวนกลับมา
cards.meaning: Rebuild a stock through a renewing inflow
cards.simple: Rebuild a stock through a renewing inflow
cards.book_ctx: Fish reproduce at a stock-dependent rate
cards.example: Measure how regeneration changes when the stock is sparse.

cards.thai: จุดวิกฤตที่ความสามารถในการฟื้นตัวเปลี่ยนอย่างมาก
cards.meaning: A level beyond which the system's ability to recover changes sharply
cards.simple: A level beyond which the system's ability to recover changes sharply
cards.book_ctx: Very low fish stock may lose regenerative capacity
cards.example: A threshold claim needs evidence about behavior on both sides.

cards.thai: ถูกจำกัดด้วยอัตราการไหลหรือการฟื้นตัว
cards.meaning: Constrained by the sustainable rate of renewal
cards.simple: Constrained by the sustainable rate of renewal
cards.book_ctx: Renewable harvest cannot indefinitely exceed regeneration
cards.example: A renewable stock is flow-limited even when its amount appears large.

cards.thai: เกินระดับที่ยั่งยืนก่อนกลไกปรับสมดุลจะควบคุมได้
cards.meaning: Move beyond a sustainable level before corrective feedback dominates
cards.simple: Move beyond a sustainable level before corrective feedback dominates
cards.book_ctx: Fishing capital and harvest can grow past sustainable equilibrium
cards.example: Identify which delay lets the activity overshoot its constraint.

cards.thai: ความยืดหยุ่นและความสามารถในการฟื้นตัว
cards.meaning: Ability to survive disturbance and recover functioning
cards.simple: Ability to survive disturbance and recover functioning
cards.book_ctx: Multiple restorative loops preserve a system in variable conditions
cards.example: Stable output does not prove resilience.

cards.thai: ความเปราะบาง
cards.meaning: Tendency to break rather than adapt or recover
cards.simple: Tendency to break rather than adapt or recover
cards.book_ctx: Opposite of resilience
cards.example: Removing all spare capacity may increase brittleness.

cards.thai: ความซ้ำซ้อนเพื่อสำรอง
cards.meaning: More than one pathway able to perform a needed function
cards.simple: More than one pathway able to perform a needed function
cards.book_ctx: One restorative loop can act if another fails
cards.example: Verify that redundant paths do not share the same failure mode.

cards.thai: การจัดระเบียบและสร้างโครงสร้างใหม่ได้ด้วยตนเอง
cards.meaning: Capacity to create and evolve new structure
cards.simple: Capacity to create and evolve new structure
cards.book_ctx: Simple rules can generate complex forms
cards.example: A team needs variation and feedback before a new practice can self-organize.

cards.thai: ลำดับชั้นของระบบย่อยที่ซ้อนอยู่ในระบบใหญ่
cards.meaning: Systems nested within larger systems
cards.simple: Systems nested within larger systems
cards.book_ctx: Cells, organs, organisms, teams, and societies
cards.example: Map what each level regulates locally.

cards.thai: แยกเป็นส่วนย่อยได้บางส่วน
cards.meaning: Separable enough for subsystems to function partly alone
cards.simple: Separable enough for subsystems to function partly alone
cards.book_ctx: Dense internal links allow useful subsystem study
cards.example: Treat the unit independently only within the stated boundary.

cards.thai: การทำให้ส่วนย่อยดีขึ้นแต่ทำให้ระบบรวมแย่ลง
cards.meaning: Improving a subsystem goal at the expense of the whole
cards.simple: Improving a subsystem goal at the expense of the whole
cards.book_ctx: Local goals can defeat the larger purpose
cards.example: A local speed metric may shift errors downstream.

cards.thai: ความสอดคล้องกัน
cards.meaning: Useful correspondence between a model and what it represents
cards.simple: Useful correspondence between a model and what it represents
cards.book_ctx: Models can fit parts of the world without being complete
cards.example: Test whether the predicted pattern is congruent with observed history.

cards.thai: ความสัมพันธ์แบบไม่เชิงเส้น
cards.meaning: Relationship whose effect is not proportional across the range
cards.simple: Relationship whose effect is not proportional across the range
cards.book_ctx: A larger input can have a smaller, larger, zero, or reversed effect
cards.example: Check whether added workload changes delay at a constant rate.

cards.thai: ผลกระทบที่อยู่นอกจุดสนใจ
cards.meaning: A consequence excluded from the focal purpose or boundary
cards.simple: A consequence excluded from the focal purpose or boundary
cards.book_ctx: The label often hides connected effects
cards.example: Trace where the displaced cost returns to the system.

cards.thai: ปัจจัยจำกัดที่เป็นคอขวดในขณะนั้น
cards.meaning: Necessary factor currently constraining performance most
cards.simple: Necessary factor currently constraining performance most
cards.book_ctx: The shortest effective input controls growth
cards.example: More reviewers will not help if usable information is limiting.

cards.thai: เหตุผลที่ถูกจำกัดด้วยข้อมูลและเงื่อนไข
cards.meaning: Reasonable local choice under limited information and constraints
cards.simple: Reasonable local choice under limited information and constraints
cards.book_ctx: Local choices can aggregate into an unwanted whole
cards.example: Map what the decision maker can see before judging the choice.

cards.thai: ผู้เลือกทางเลือกที่ดีพอภายใต้ข้อจำกัด
cards.meaning: Decision maker seeking an adequate available option rather than a perfect optimum
cards.simple: Decision maker seeking an adequate available option rather than a perfect optimum
cards.book_ctx: Actors act before surveying every possibility
cards.example: A manager may choose the first feasible capacity fix.

cards.thai: แรงต้านเชิงนโยบายจากการตอบโต้กัน
cards.meaning: Counteractions that hold a shared state despite policy effort
cards.simple: Counteractions that hold a shared state despite policy effort
cards.book_ctx: Incompatible actor goals create a standoff
cards.example: Check whether one department's correction triggers another's countermove.

cards.thai: ทรัพยากรร่วมหรือพื้นที่รองรับของเสียร่วม
cards.meaning: Shared, limited resource source or waste sink
cards.simple: Shared, limited resource source or waste sink
cards.book_ctx: Private benefits and shared costs weaken feedback
cards.example: A shared meeting capacity can be congested, but only if use degrades access.

cards.thai: การลดมาตรฐานตามผลงานที่แย่ลง
cards.meaning: Lowering standards in response to poor perceived performance
cards.simple: Lowering standards in response to poor perceived performance
cards.book_ctx: Lower standards reduce corrective action
cards.example: Preserve an independent service standard across bad weeks.

cards.thai: การยกระดับแข่งขันตอบโต้กัน
cards.meaning: Reinforcing competition driven by relative targets
cards.simple: Reinforcing competition driven by relative targets
cards.book_ctx: Each move raises the other's target
cards.example: Verify that one team's target actually follows the other's score.

cards.thai: การกีดกันคู่แข่งออกจากพื้นที่แข่งขัน
cards.meaning: Cumulative advantage eliminates rivals from a shared niche
cards.simple: Cumulative advantage eliminates rivals from a shared niche
cards.book_ctx: Winners receive resources to win again
cards.example: Compare later access before calling repeated success cumulative advantage.

cards.thai: การผลักภาระการแก้ปัญหาไปยังผู้แทรกแซง
cards.meaning: Replacing root correction with repeated symptom relief
cards.simple: Replacing root correction with repeated symptom relief
cards.book_ctx: Outside help can erode self-maintaining capacity
cards.example: Track whether support restores or replaces internal capability.

cards.thai: การเลี่ยงเจตนารมณ์ของกฎโดยทำตามตัวอักษร
cards.meaning: Meeting a rule's letter while defeating its purpose
cards.simple: Meeting a rule's letter while defeating its purpose
cards.book_ctx: Self-organization searches for permitted loopholes
cards.example: Examine purpose-level outcomes alongside compliance.

cards.thai: ปริมาณการไหลผ่านต่อช่วงเวลา
cards.meaning: Material or activity flow over a period
cards.simple: Material or activity flow over a period
cards.book_ctx: A flow metric can be mistaken for welfare or durable stock
cards.example: Count resolved value, not activity alone.

cards.thai: จุดคานงัดของระบบ
cards.meaning: A place where a change can alter system behavior
cards.simple: A place where a change can alter system behavior
cards.book_ctx: Intervention sites range from parameters to paradigms
cards.example: Changing who sees queue age can alter approval action.

cards.thai: สต็อกกันชน
cards.meaning: A stock large enough relative to its flows to absorb variation
cards.simple: A stock large enough relative to its flows to absorb variation
cards.book_ctx: Buffer size affects stability and responsiveness
cards.example: Review capacity can absorb a short draft surge.

cards.thai: การไหลของข้อมูล
cards.meaning: A pathway that makes system state visible to a decision point
cards.simple: A pathway that makes system state visible to a decision point
cards.book_ctx: Missing information can remove a feedback loop
cards.example: Show rework rate to the team choosing release speed.

cards.thai: กรอบความคิดพื้นฐาน
cards.meaning: A deep shared model from which goals, rules, and structures arise
cards.simple: A deep shared model from which goals, rules, and structures arise
cards.book_ctx: Paradigm change can reshape lower intervention levels
cards.example: Ask what belief makes the current metric seem like success.

cards.thai: การก้าวพ้นกรอบความคิด
cards.meaning: Ability to hold a model lightly and release it when evidence requires
cards.simple: Ability to hold a model lightly and release it when evidence requires
cards.book_ctx: Highest-ranked leverage is freedom from attachment to one paradigm
cards.example: Compare rival models before committing to one diagnosis.

cards.thai: ความรับผิดชอบที่เชื่อมผลกลับถึงผู้ตัดสินใจ
cards.meaning: Feedback that connects decision makers to consequences of their decisions
cards.simple: Feedback that connects decision makers to consequences of their decisions
cards.book_ctx: Consequence information should reach the originating choice
cards.example: Return downstream correction cost to the design review.

cards.thai: นโยบายปรับตัวตามข้อมูลย้อนกลับ
cards.meaning: A policy that monitors results and changes with system feedback
cards.simple: A policy that monitors results and changes with system feedback
cards.book_ctx: Uncertainty calls for learning and revision
cards.example: Set a review rule that changes capacity when backlog signals cross a range.

cards.thai: กรอบเวลาในการวิเคราะห์
cards.meaning: The span over which behavior and consequences are examined
cards.simple: The span over which behavior and consequences are examined
cards.book_ctx: Fast and slow processes are nested
cards.example: Evaluate a weekly gain alongside quarterly capability erosion.
